author: Smoebo
generator: Grok Build command-line tool 1.0.60, image_gen, one call per plate with the prompt recorded here unchanged
subjectBasis: Original designs for entries of the steampunk bestiary (src/lib/bestiary/steampunk.json), per docs/art/creature-art-guidance.md: its people, its machines and the creatures whose fantasy plate was the wrong picture. No published illustration, film character or real person was named or supplied as an input.
encoding: Each 1024x1024 JPEG original resized once to 256x256 (cover) and encoded once to WebP quality 75 with sharp.
review: Each shipped plate was viewed at full size and in a round crop at 96px and 40px on dark and light surrounds. Four are second paintings: the feminine cathedral engineer came back inside a painted gold disc, and the neutral campaigner, union buster and pugilist read as men until the second prompt covered the face. The Peer of the Realm is painted as the person the card presents; the vampire it fights as is left to the reveal.
